content.text: Role: CEO/Operations Director of “Progress service ” shoe factory. I manage production and wholesale shoe trade throughout Ukraine, plus we’re working on expanding to international markets.
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Role: CEO/Operations Director of “Progress service ” shoe factory. I manage production and wholesale shoe trade throughout Ukraine, plus we’re working on expanding to international markets.

content.text: Business/Organization: Shoe manufacturing factory focused on implementing Lean Manufacturing, TOC (Theory of Constraints), and Toyota Way principles. I also provide Lean consulting to other factories — audits, training, and system implementations.
content.circle_ios_fallback_text: Business/Organization: Shoe manufacturing factory focused on implementing Lean Manufacturing, TOC (Theory of Constraints), and Toyota Way principles. I also provide Lean consulting to other factories — audits, training, and system implementations.

content.text: Current Goals: Creating our factory’s 2026 strategy using Hoshin Kanri methodology, developing a Lean training platform (3 levels with 5 modules each), and automating our knowledge management system through Evernote + Make. I’m also working on a quote system for team morning meetings.

content.text: Interest in AI: Actively using Claude for translating educational materials (just completed translating the complete Claude course into Ukrainian), structuring brainstorms, and creating training content. I’m interested in building my own AI Operating System to systematize all business processes — from strategic planning to daily operations.
